english_meaning: The true God who alone deserves to be worshipped
bahasa_meaning: Nama khas bagi Tuhan yang sebenar-benarnya, yang berhak disembah dengan penuh kecintaan, pengagungan, dan ketundukan
proof_text: إِنَّنِي أَنَا اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدْنِي وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ لِذِكْرِي
aqeedah_belief: The supreme proper name of God that encompasses all of His beautiful Names and Attributes. It indicates His absolute Lordship, absolute Divinity (Uluhiyyah), and His unique right to be worshipped exclusively without partners.
salah_usage: Bring complete presence of heart during the opening Takbeer (Allahu Akbar) and reflect on His sole divinity.
dua_usage: Invoke using Ya Allah for comprehensive worldly and spiritual needs, as it is the most encompassing supplication.
dhikr_usage: Constantly repeat La ilaha illa Allah (There is no deity except Allah) and Subhan Allah (Glory be to Allah) to purify the soul.
when_to_invoke: In times of severe distress, when seeking total guidance, and when renewing one's sincerity and monotheism.
ghazali_insight: This name is the greatest of the ninety-nine names of God because it refers to the essence which unites all the attributes of divinity, so that none of them is left out. Man's share in this name should be for his heart and aspiration to be completely taken up with God, looking to none other and fearing none other.
description_en: Allah is the proper name of the Supreme Being. It is the majestic, all-encompassing name that forms the very core of Islamic monotheism (Tawhid). It is never given to any creation, literally or metaphorically. When a believer says Allah, they are calling upon the One who holds the keys to the unseen, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, and the source of all existence.
description_ms: Allah ialah nama khas bagi Zat Yang Maha Suci, Pencipta sekalian alam. Nama agung ini menghimpunkan segala sifat kesempurnaan, keagungan, dan keindahan-Nya. Menyebut nama Allah dengan penuh adab akan menumbuhkan rasa cinta yang mendalam, membangkitkan ketundukan jiwa, dan mengukuhkan tauhid di dalam hati sanubari seorang mukmin.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 51-52; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 15-20; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa.
al_jalil_commentary: Focuses on refining sincerity (Ikhlas) and establishing love, fear, and hope (Al-Mahabbah, Al-Khawf, Al-Raja') inside the heart, which are the pillars of true worship.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Tunggal dalam Zat, Sifat, dan Perbuatan-Nya
proof_text: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah is absolutely unique, indivisible, and without partner, peer, or equal. He is singular in His Being and His Attributes, and there is absolutely nothing like unto Him in the universe.
salah_usage: Recite Surah Al-Ikhlas in daily prayers with deep contemplation of His absolute uniqueness and independence.
dua_usage: Supplicate to Ya Al-Ahad to keep your heart firm on monotheism and free from any attachment to creation.
dhikr_usage: Say Ya Al-Ahad to anchor the heart in divine singularity and detach from worldly illusions.
when_to_invoke: When feeling lonely, when facing peer pressure to compromise one's faith, or when purifying one's heart from hidden shirk (polytheism).
ghazali_insight: When we see two terms that are close in meaning, it must be due to one of two reasons: First, that one of them is outside the ninety-nine names, such as Al-Ahad (The Unique) and Al-Wahid (The One). Al-Ahad represents the absolute unity that can neither be divided in His essence nor duplicated in His attributes.
description_en: Al-Ahad is the Name that signifies Allah's absolute uniqueness and indivisibility. Unlike Al-Wahid (The One), which can signify being first in a sequence, Al-Ahad emphasizes that there is no second, no partner, and no equal whatsoever. He is completely singular in His majesty and glory, transcending any concept of composition or physical parts.
description_ms: Al-Ahad ialah nama agung yang menegaskan bahawa Allah Maha Tunggal dan tidak boleh dibahagi-bahagikan. Dia Esa dalam segala Sifat keagungan-Nya, tanpa ada sekutu, tandingan, atau pembantu. Sifat ketunggalan ini membersihkan jiwa mukmin daripada bergantung kepada makhluk, serta mengarahkan segala ibadah dan pergantungan hanya kepada-Nya.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 17, 134; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 55-60; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa.
al_jalil_commentary: Cultivates pure reliance (Tawakkul) by realizing that since Allah is uniquely the only controller of benefit and harm, the heart should seek help and fear only Him.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Tinggi Sifat, Kedudukan, dan Kekuasaan-Nya mengatasi segala sesuatu
proof_text: سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى
aqeedah_belief: Belief in Allah's absolute highness (Uluww) in three dimensions: His Highness of status and attributes, His Highness of subjugation and power, and His Highness of Being (Dhat) above His Throne, transcending all creation.
salah_usage: Say Subhana Rabbiyal A'laa (Glory be to my Lord the Most High) during prostration, placing your highest part (the forehead) on the lowest ground in complete humility.
dua_usage: Invoke Ya Al-A'laa to elevate your spiritual rank and grant victory over injustice.
dhikr_usage: Repeat Subhana Rabbiyal A'laa to establish humility in the soul and declare Allah's supreme position.
when_to_invoke: When feeling small or oppressed, when facing situations of arrogance in others, or during prostration to humble oneself.
ghazali_insight: Al-Ghazali notes that the most exalted creation (the Prophet ﷺ) was given this Name as a veil of Divine Reality, for only Allah truly knows the ultimate depth of His High status. High status in servants is achieved by elevating one's aspiration above sensory desires.
description_en: Al-A'laa denotes Allah's supreme elevation above everything in existence. His Highness is absolute and flawless—transcending physical height, He is High in His majestic status, His ultimate dominion, and His lofty Essence. He reigns supreme above the heavens, and everything else is under His absolute control and superior authority.
description_ms: Al-A'laa menunjukkan bahawa Allah Maha Tinggi dalam segala aspek tanpa sebarang bandingan. Ketinggian-Nya meliputi Zat, Sifat, dan kekuasaan-Nya yang mutlak di atas seluruh makhluk. Menyedari sifat ketinggian Allah melahirkan rasa kerdil dalam diri manusia, membuang sifat takbur dan ego, serta menanam kesetiaan yang mutlak kepada perintah-Nya.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 26, 47; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 110-115; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa.
al_jalil_commentary: Teaches the believer to lower themselves in absolute submission, removing all pride, since all highness belongs exclusively to the Lord of the worlds.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Pemurah dan Maha Mulia melebihi segala bentuk kemurahan makhluk
proof_text: اقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah's generosity (Karam) is infinite and unmatched. He gives without being asked, multiplies small deeds into massive rewards, forgives major sins upon sincere repentance, and bestows blessings without expecting anything in return.
salah_usage: Reflect on Al-Akram's endless giving during Ruku and Sujud, begging Him for His noble rewards and bounty.
dua_usage: Call upon Ya Al-Akram to grant success in studies, increase in useful knowledge, and abundance in provision.
dhikr_usage: Say Ya Al-Akram to remind yourself of the boundless ocean of divine grace and to foster gratitude.
when_to_invoke: When seeking knowledge, when initiating a new project (like writing or reading), or when feeling unworthy or despairing of Allah's forgiveness.
ghazali_insight: True generosity (Karam) in the absolute sense belongs only to Allah, who forgives when He is able, fulfills when He promises, and exceeds expectations when He gives. A servant's share is to be generous with their wealth, knowledge, and kindness towards others without expecting return.
description_en: Al-Akram is the superlative form of Al-Karim, representing the apex of generosity, nobility, and kindness. While Al-Karim is generous, Al-Akram is the Most Generous, whose giving has no boundaries and whose tolerance of His servants' shortcomings is infinite. He initiated creation out of pure generosity and sustains them with unceasing blessings.
description_ms: Al-Akram melambangkan kemuncak kemurahan dan kemuliaan Allah yang tiada tandingan. Dia memberi sebelum diminta, mengurniakan ganjaran berlipat kali ganda ke atas amalan yang sedikit, dan mengampunkan dosa-dosa besar apabila hamba-Nya bertaubat. Nama ini mula-mula diturunkan dalam wahyu pertama untuk menunjukkan bahawa kurniaan ilmu dan bimbingan al-Quran adalah tanda terbesar kemurahan-Nya.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 94; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 130-135; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa.
al_jalil_commentary: Links the first revelation of "Read! and your Lord is the Most Generous" to show that Allah's greatest generosity is the gift of revelation, knowledge, and the intellect to understand His signs.

english_meaning: The One Who alone deserves to be worshipped
bahasa_meaning: Tuhan Yang Sebenar, yang berhak disembah dan diabdikan diri kepada-Nya secara mutlak
proof_text: وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ ۖ لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah is the only true object of adoration, love, and submission. All other false gods, idols, desires, and worldly forces are invalid objects of worship. Tawhid al-Uluhiyyah is built entirely upon this Name.
salah_usage: Focus intensely on the phrase Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nasta'in (You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help) as the practical realization of Al-Ilaah.
dua_usage: Use Ya Ilaahi (O my Lord/God) when begging for spiritual steadfastness and protection from deviation.
dhikr_usage: Say La ilaha illa Allah continuously as a direct affirmation of the name Al-Ilaah, purifying the soul from minor associations.
when_to_invoke: When refining your intention (Niyyah), when protecting your heart from showing off (Riya'), or when renewing the declaration of faith (Shahadah).
ghazali_insight: Al-Ilaah represents the true existent who unites all the attributes of divinity, making Him the sole legitimate target of devotion and worship. The servant's share is to turn their heart completely away from worldly deities like money, status, or self-desires.
description_en: Al-Ilaah is the direct Quranic term for 'The Deity' who possesses the absolute right to be worshipped. While 'Rabb' emphasizes creation, ownership, and lordship, Al-Ilaah focuses on the relationship of worship, love, fear, hope, and absolute submission that creatures owe to their Creator. It is the defining word in the test of faith.
description_ms: Al-Ilaah merujuk kepada Tuhan yang sebenar-benarnya berhak disembah dan ditaati secara mutlak. Nama ini menegaskan kebatilan segala sembahan selain-Nya, sama ada patung, berhala, mahupun hawa nafsu dan kebendaan duniawi. Mengesakan Allah sebagai Al-Ilaah bermakna menyucikan segala niat, cinta, dan ketakutan hanya untuk keredaan-Nya.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 51, 62; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 25-30; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa.
al_jalil_commentary: Focuses on the psychology of worship—realizing that the human heart has an innate need (fitrah) to love, revere, and deify a supreme being, and this need can only be fully satisfied by Al-Ilaah.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Awal, yang tiada permulaan bagi kewujudan-Nya
proof_text: هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah existed before anything else did. He is the Uncreated Creator, the first cause of all existence. His existence is eternal and uninitiated, having absolutely no beginning in time or space.
salah_usage: Reflect during the early morning prayer (Fajr) on how Allah initiated your life and this day out of His sheer grace.
dua_usage: Supplicate using Ya Al-Awwal to bless your beginnings, launch successful endeavors, and keep you steadfast from day one.
dhikr_usage: Say Ya Al-Awwal to find comfort that Allah was there before any of your troubles or difficulties ever began.
when_to_invoke: At the beginning of any major project, when starting a new day, or when reflecting on the origin of creation and destiny.
ghazali_insight: When you ponder the order of existence and consider the ordered chain of beings, God the most high is first with respect to it, since all of them receive their existence from Him, and He does not receive existence from another but is existent by His essence. He is the first beginning and initiator of all.
description_en: Al-Awwal signifies that Allah stands before time itself. He is not bound by the chronological order of the universe, as He created time. Understanding Al-Awwal liberates the mind from the paradox of infinite regress, establishing that all of creation flows from a singular, eternal, and uncaused Originator.
description_ms: Al-Awwal bermaksud Allah Yang Maha Awal tanpa ada permulaan bagi kewujudan-Nya. Sifat ini menegaskan bahawa Dia mendahului segala makhluk dan masa, kerana Dialah Pencipta masa itu sendiri. Menyedari nama Al-Awwal melatih seorang hamba untuk sentiasa mendahulukan keredaan Allah, memulakan setiap urusan dengan nama-Nya, dan meyakini bahawa segalanya bermula daripada kudrat-Nya.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 133-134; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 210-215; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa.
al_jalil_commentary: Teaches the believer to prioritize Allah in all aspects of life (putting His commands first, starting with His name, and seeking His pleasure before all else).

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Akhir, yang kekal abadi tanpa ada kesudahan bagi kewujudan-Nya
proof_text: هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah will exist for all eternity after all creation perishes. He is infinite and everlasting, having no end, no death, and no disappearance. He remains when everything else fades away.
salah_usage: Reflect during the closing Tashahhud on the transient nature of this world and the eternal nature of the afterlife with Allah.
dua_usage: Call upon Ya Al-Aakhir to grant a good end to your life (Husn al-Khatimah) and bless the outcomes of your deeds.
dhikr_usage: Say Ya Al-Aakhir to anchor your hopes in the eternal Divine, rather than the temporary and fleeting pleasures of this world.
when_to_invoke: When dealing with anxiety about the future, when experiencing the death of loved ones, or at the end of a project or life stage.
ghazali_insight: Whenever you ponder the order of wayfaring and observe the stages attained by those journeying towards Him, He is the last, for He is the final point to which the levels of 'knowers' ascend. The highest stage is knowledge of God. So He is last with respect to wayfaring.
description_en: Al-Aakhir represents the ultimate finality of all things returning to their Creator. In a world where everything decays and disappears, Al-Aakhir is the permanent anchor. He is the ultimate destination of the spiritual journey, the ultimate judge of all affairs, and the Only One who remains when the universe is folded up.
description_ms: Al-Aakhir bererti Allah Yang Maha Akhir, yang kekal abadi tanpa ada kesudahan bagi kewujudan-Nya. Tatkala seluruh alam ini hancur dan binasa, Dialah yang tetap kekal. Memahami nama Al-Aakhir mendidik jiwa mukmin untuk tidak bergantung kepada kebendaan dunia yang sementara, sebaliknya sentiasa bersiap sedia dengan amalan soleh untuk menghadapi hari pertemuan abadi dengan-Nya.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 133-134; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 216-220; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa.
al_jalil_commentary: Encourages preparing for the ultimate return to Allah, cultivating sincere actions that will endure in the afterlife rather than transient worldly fame.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Zahir, yang ketinggian dan tanda-tanda kewujudan-Nya sangat nyata di atas segala sesuatu
proof_text: هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah is supreme, uppermost, and dominant over all. Nothing is above Him. His existence is clearly manifest through His magnificent signs in the universe, and He towers over His creation in power, status, and Essence.
salah_usage: Reflect on the vastness of the heavens and earth during standing (Qiyam), seeing them as signs of His manifest dominance.
dua_usage: Pray to Ya Adh-Dhaahir to make the truth clear and manifest, and to grant victory and dominance over falsehood.
dhikr_usage: Recite Ya Adh-Dhaahir to witness His power in every atom of the cosmos and remove doubt from your heart.
when_to_invoke: When seeking clarity and truth, when defending against false accusations, or when feeling defeated by worldly powers.
ghazali_insight: God is hidden when He is sought by sensory perception or using the resources of imagination, yet manifest when sought by way of inference using the resources of reason. He is hidden in His manifestations by the intense way in which He is manifest, as His very light acts as His veil.
description_en: Adh-Dhaahir denotes the One who is supreme and dominant, above whom there is absolutely nothing. Yet He is also the Manifest, whose existence, majesty, and wisdom are clearly visible in the incredible design of the cosmos. He is hidden from physical sight, but His presence is the most obvious reality to any intellect.
description_ms: Adh-Dhaahir bermaksud Allah Yang Maha Nyata, yang tanda-tanda kebesaran dan kewujudan-Nya sangat jelas terpampang di seluruh alam semesta. Nama ini juga bermakna Dia Maha Tinggi mengatasi segala kekuatan makhluk, tanpa ada sebarang kuasa yang mampu mengatasi-Nya. Memahami sifat ini menguatkan tauhid dan membebaskan mukmin daripada sebarang rasa gentar terhadap kekuasaan batil di dunia.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 134-137; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 221-225; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa.
al_jalil_commentary: Teaches the believer to act with transparency and integrity, aligning their outward behavior with their inward faith, knowing that Allah's dominance is manifest over all.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Tersembunyi, yang amat dekat dan mengetahui segala rahsia yang paling dalam
proof_text: هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah is the closest to everything, knowing the innermost secrets, thoughts, and intentions of all hearts. He cannot be perceived by the physical senses in this world, yet nothing is hidden from Him.
salah_usage: Guard your thoughts and focus during prayer, knowing that Al-Baatin is fully watching the movements of your heart, not just your limbs.
dua_usage: Supplicate Ya Al-Baatin to purify your secrets, forgive your hidden sins, and align your inner thoughts with His guidance.
dhikr_usage: Say Ya Al-Baatin to cultivate self-monitoring (Muraqabah) and clean the inner state from pride and envy.
when_to_invoke: When purifying one's heart from bad intentions, when dealing with private struggles, or when needing comfort that Allah knows your silent pain.
ghazali_insight: Allah is hidden (Batin) when sought by sensory perception or imagination, for He is too exalted to be attained by senses. Yet He is closer to the soul than its own self. Man's share is to cultivate beautiful inner qualities that are hidden from public eyes.
description_en: Al-Baatin represents the intimate closeness of Allah. He is the Knower of all secrets, closer to us than our jugular vein, yet He remains completely imperceptible to our physical eyes in this world. Understanding Al-Baatin forces the believer to realize that their private life, their secret thoughts, and their unspoken fears are completely laid bare before their Lord.
description_ms: Al-Baatin bererti Allah Yang Maha Tersembunyi, yang tidak dapat dijangkau oleh panca indera fizikal manusia di dunia ini, namun sangat dekat dengan hamba-Nya. Dialah yang mengetahui segala bisikan hati, rahsia tersembunyi, dan niat yang paling dalam. Nama agung ini melatih seorang muslim untuk sentiasa menjaga keikhlasan hati dan menjauhi maksiat lisan mahupun rahsia.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 134-137; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 226-230; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa.
al_jalil_commentary: Emphasizes purifying the inner dimensions of the heart (Al-Sarayir) because Allah looks at the heart and the intention, not just the outward appearance and actions.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Merancang dan Mewujudkan ciptaan daripada tiada kepada ada dengan keserasian yang sempurna
proof_text: هُوَ اللَّهُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ ۖ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah brings creation from non-existence into actual existence in perfect alignment with His pre-decreed plans. He originates the creation with flawless compatibility and harmony, free from any defects or disproportion.
salah_usage: Thank Allah during Sujud for creating your body in perfect proportion and harmony, reflecting on the beauty of His design.
dua_usage: Pray to Ya Al-Baari' to heal your body, restore balance and harmony in your affairs, and free your life from distress.
dhikr_usage: Chant Ya Al-Baari' to marvel at the seamless order of nature and align your own actions with divine harmony.
when_to_invoke: When seeking healing from physical illnesses, when experiencing disruption in your life's harmony, or when initiating a creative or builder's task.
ghazali_insight: Al-Khaliq is the planner, Al-Bari' is the producer who brings things into existence according to the plan, and Al-Musawwir is the fashioner. Everything which comes forth from nothing to existence needs first of all to be planned; secondly, to be originated according to the plan; and thirdly, to be formed after being originated.
description_en: Al-Baari' is the One who executes the creation of things from absolute nothingness, ensuring that each part is perfectly matched and proportioned to its environment and purpose. He is the divine builder who transforms abstract plans into a concrete, living, and harmoniously functioning reality.
description_ms: Al-Baari' merujuk kepada Allah Yang Maha Mewujudkan ciptaan daripada tiada kepada ada dengan penuh keseimbangan dan keharmonian. Berbeza dengan Al-Khaliq (Yang Merancang), Al-Baari' adalah yang melunaskan perancangan tersebut menjadi realiti fizikal yang serasi dan sempurna tanpa sebarang kecacatan. Memahami nama ini melahirkan rasa syukur yang mendalam atas kejadian fizikal diri kita dan keindahan alam sekitar.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 68-72; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 70-75; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa.
al_jalil_commentary: Teaches the believer to accept and love their physical form and appearance, knowing that Al-Baari' is the One who originated them in the absolute best and most suited shape.

proof_text: Truly, He is The Source of Goodness, The Compassionate.
aqeedah_belief: Allah showers His apparent and hidden blessings upon His slaves. All His creation totally depends on Him at all times and cannot do without His absolute kindness. He multiplies the rewards of the righteous among the Muslims and forgives the wrongdoers among them, and His promise is true.
salah_usage: Let this Name soften the heart before takbir so your salah flows with compassion.
dua_usage: Call upon Al-Barr when pleading for forgiveness for yourself, family, and the ummah.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Barr dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.
when_to_invoke: Reach for this Name whenever you seek Allah's rahmah after shortcomings.
ghazali_insight: mmentary after §85.] 79. [muhsin] — Al-Barr . the Doer of Good — is the beneficent one The absolute doer of good is the one from whom every good deed and beneficence comes. Man can be a doer of good only in the measure that he keeps himself occupied with doing good, especially towards his parents, teachers, and elders. that while his Lord peace be upon him It is told of Moses was speaking to him he saw a man standing
description_en: Al-Barr reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Barr mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.103; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv
al_jalil_commentary: He is the source of all righteousness, kindness, and goodness, whose grace encompasses all of creation. For the believer, this name inspires profound love and gratitude, and encourages them to seek righteousness, knowing that Allah is kind to His servants and true to His promises.

proof_text: Allah is sufficient as a witness.

proof_text: He is Allah; there is none worthy of worship except for Him; the Sovereign, the Holy, the Source of Peace, the Granter of Security...

al_jalil_commentary: As-Salaam is The One who is free from all defects and the very source of all peace and security. A believer who seeks true peace for themself, their family, or society will find it only through faith in Him and adherence to His laws. This understanding motivates the believer to be an agent of peace, spreading greetings and refraining from all forms of harm against others.

proof_text: Surely, He is aware of and sees His servants.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One whose sight encompasses everything that is conceivable, hidden or apparent, no matter how hidden or small it may be.
salah_usage: Ask for hikmah after reciting Al-Fatihah so knowledge leads to action.
dua_usage: Say Ya As-Sami when seeking guidance for decisions beyond your limited sight.
dhikr_usage: Zikir Ya As-Sami ketika menuntut ilmu agar pemahaman disulami tawaduk.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you ask Allah to open understanding beyond data.
ghazali_insight: As-Sami' is the one from whose perception nothing audible is removed, hearing even the most hidden secrets without a physical ear. Man's share is to realize God hears him and so watch his tongue, and to use his own hearing to listen to the word of God.
description_en: As-Sami reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.

al_jalil_commentary: Belief in As-Samee' (The All-Hearing) should lead one to be mindful of Allah in all that the tongue utters, whether in secret or public, instilling fear of Him and guarding the tongue from foul speech. proof_text: Allah is ever Watchful over all things.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One whose hearing, seeing and knowledge encompass everything and the One from whom nothing is hidden.

al_jalil_commentary: Belief that Allah is Ash-Shaheed (The Witness) over creation on the Day of Judgment makes the believer wary of wronging others or violating their rights. It also compels the believer to strive for sincerity and piety in their words and deeds, knowing Allah witnesses what is in their hearts and accepts only what is done purely for Him and is correct.

Certainty that Allah is aware of one's outer state and inner reality cultivates a profound sense of God-consciousness (murāqabah). This motivates the believer to maintain righteousness in both public and private, and to purify the heart from hidden ills that people cannot see.

proof_text: …And know that Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.
aqeedah_belief: He is the All-Strong, All-Dominant who reigns supreme over His creatures. He has subjugated all His creatures, all of whom have humbled themselves before Him and have totally submitted to His authority.

al_jalil_commentary: He is the Invincible, the Unreachable, the All-Conquering, possessing all meanings of might and honor. english_meaning: The Tremendous One or the Magnificent
proof_text: He is the Sublime, the Tremendous.
aqeedah_belief: This name comprises all attributes of greatness, majesty and glory. He is the Greatest and Tremendous in His Being, names and attributes, and thus none of His creation deserves to be exalted with the heart, the tongue and all body parts as He should be.
salah_usage: Visualise all creation bowing with you when mentioning this majestic Name.

ghazali_insight: Al-'Adheem is the one whose essence is absolutely tremendous, exceeding every intellectual limit to the point where comprehending His essence is inconceivable. al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil highlights the perfection that results from pairing Al-'Adheem (The Great) with Al-Haleem (The Forbearing). His forbearance comes from a position of strength and greatness, not weakness. Unlike human kings who may lack forbearance due to their perceived greatness, Allah's greatness is adorned with His forbearance, which is a further state of perfection.

al_jalil_commentary: Al-'Aleem is the All-Knowing, whose knowledge encompasses everything, public and private, large and small. A firm belief in His complete awareness instills a constant sense of being watched by God (murāqabah), which pushes the servant toward righteousness in all actions. It is a powerful tool for purifying the heart of hidden diseases like envy, pride, and insincerity, which are unseen by people but fully known to Him.

proof_text: …He is the Most High, the Magnificent.

when_to_invoke: Humble yourself before His highness.
ghazali_insight: Al-'Aliyy is the one above whose rank there is no rank, and all other ranks are inferior to Him. This 'height' is one of rational grading based on causality and perfection, not physical place; God is at the highest grade of all beings.
description_en: Allah has absolute highness in every sense above all else—highness with regard to His Being, majestic position, attributes and absolute dominance. He is high above His creation and everything and everyone is under His absolute control and superior authority.

al_jalil_commentary: Al-'Aliyy is The High, The Exalted, possessing absolute highness in His essence above creation, in His power over all things, and in His perfect attributes. This belief humbles the soul before Him and serves as a warning against arrogance and injustice on earth. The believer remembers that no matter how high a person rises in status or power, Allah the Exalted is always infinitely higher.

proof_text: Allah is the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One who forgives sins and accepts the repentance of all those who turn to Him; He conceals the sins of His servants, shows never-ending compassion to them and lavishes kindness on them. The word Al-Ghaffaar points to His immense and constant forgiveness of sins.
salah_usage: Lengthen sujud for istighfar whenever you recall a slip.
dua_usage: Invoke Ya Al-Ghaffar when seeking cleansing from sins, big or small.
dhikr_usage: Basahkan lidah dengan Ya Al-Ghaffar sebelum tidur supaya hati dilapangkan.
when_to_invoke: Use it whenever you return to Allah seeking pardon.
ghazali_insight: 2 [ 85] Part Two: Chapter One 15. Al-Ghaffar —He who is full of forgiveness — is the one who makes manifest what is beautiful and conceals what is ugly. Sins are among the ugly things which He conceals, by letting a cover fall over them in this world, and refraining from requiting them in the next. So forgiving is concealing. The first concealing concerning man is that He made the ugly parts of his body, which the ey
description_en: Al-Ghaffar forgives repeatedly and hides faults when servants sincerely return to Him.
description_ms: Al-Ghaffar sentiasa mengampuni dan menutup aib apabila hamba kembali dengan ikhlas.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.107; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv
al_jalil_commentary: Believing in Allah as Al-Ghaffaar instills hope and cuts off despair from His mercy, making the believer turn to Him after sinning. It opens the door of repentance for those who have transgressed, and motivates one to do good deeds as a means of attaining His vast forgiveness.

english_meaning: The Independent One Who is free of all needs
proof_text: Or do they possess the treasures of the mercy of your Lord, the All Mighty, the Ever Giving?
aqeedah_belief: Allah is so generous that His immense generosity reaches all His slaves. He grants whatever he wills to whomever He wills. This includes guidance to His true religion, sustenance and cure from diseases.
salah_usage: Raise your hands after salah accepting whatever provision Allah decrees.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Ghaniyy when asking Allah to sustain your family and community with halal rizq.
dhikr_usage: Ingatlah Ya Al-Ghaniyy ketika menyusun urusan harian supaya hati bergantung kepada Pemberi rezeki.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you feel uncertain about rizq and resources.
ghazali_insight: Al-Ghaniyy is the Rich One, who has no connection with or dependence upon another for His being or attributes. A human is always poor in relation to God, but can be called 'rich' figuratively if he becomes free from need for everything but God.
description_en: Al-Ghaniyy reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Ghaniyy mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.

al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Allah as Al-Ghaniyy (The Rich, The Self-Sufficient) brings about richness of the heart and soul. This leads to a sense of independence from people, self-esteem, and refraining from coveting what they possess, as one directs all needs to the One whose treasures are infinite.

english_meaning: The Judge and Opener Who distinguishes the truth from falsehood
proof_text: And He is the All-Knowing Superb Arbiter.
aqeedah_belief: He judges between His servants, opens the doors of sustenance and mercy for them, as well as the doors closed in their faces and thus makes things easy for them.
salah_usage: Let this Name soften the heart before takbir so your salah flows with compassion.

al_jalil_commentary: He is the Able, the one who possesses the power to do a thing. This name and its more intensive forms (Al-Qadeer, Al-Muqtadir) foster complete trust and reliance on Allah, who is capable of all things, and instill a fear of oppressing others by reminding the believer of Allah's ultimate power over them.

proof_text: …And He is the One, the All-Dominant.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One before whom everyone, including tyrants, is humbled. He is also the One who prevails over all His creation and to whom everyone and everything submits.
dua_usage: Humble your ego before His power.
when_to_invoke: Humble your ego before His power.
description_en: He is the One before whom everyone, including tyrants, is humbled. He is also the One who prevails over all His creation and to whom everyone and everything submits.

al_jalil_commentary: He is the One who subjugates and holds dominion over His creation, who is supreme above them. This Name, along with Al-Qahhaar, instills glorification of Allah, fear of Him alone, and the affirmation of His absolute highness (fawqiyyah) above all of creation.

proof_text: …The Sovereign Lord, the Holy, the Exalted in Mighty, the All-Wise.
aqeedah_belief: He is free of any imperfection, and evil is not attributed to Him, for all perfect and sublime attributes belong to Him.
salah_usage: Before takbir, breathe in and ask Allah to remove ego residue.
dua_usage: Use Ya Al-Quddus when begging Allah to purify your body, heart, and surroundings.
dhikr_usage: Baca Subbuhun Quddusun selepas wudu agar ibadah bermula dengan kesucian.
when_to_invoke: Call it whenever you wish to cleanse your intentions and worship.
ghazali_insight: to dispense with everything. 5. — Al-Quddus the Holy — is the one who is free from every attribute which a sense might perceive, or imagination may conceive, or to which imagination may instinctively turn or by which the conscience may be moved, or which thinking demands. english_meaning: The One Who is near to the servants
proof_text: Indeed, my Lord is Ever Near, ready to answer.
aqeedah_belief: Allah favourably responds to the supplications and requests of His slaves. He answers their supplications and grants their requests.
dua_usage: Call upon Him with the certainty that He is close.
when_to_invoke: Call upon Him with the certainty that He is close.
description_en: Allah favourably responds to the supplications and requests of His slaves. He answers their supplications and grants their requests.

al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Al-Qareeb (The Near) has two effects. The belief in His general nearness to all creation via His knowledge and observation inspires fear, watchfulness, and modesty. The belief in His special nearness to His worshippers inspires hope, prevents despair, and leads one to supplicate to Him with intimacy, turning away from intermediaries.

proof_text: …He is the All-Strong, the All-Mighty.
aqeedah_belief: He is the All-Powerful, to whom perfect power belongs. His commands are carried out, He is never overpowered, His decree cannot be averted and whatever He decrees certainly takes place. He gives assistance and support to the believers and severely punishes those who disbelieve His signs and arrogant
salah_usage: Lengthen qiyam and feel supported by the One who can never be overcome.
dua_usage: Invoke Ya Al-Qawiyy when asking for courage to defend the truth.

when_to_invoke: Invoke it during you require strength to stand upon the truth.
ghazali_insight: Al-Qawiyy, the Strong, indicates perfect and utmost power. Al-Matin (the Firm) indicates the intensification of that strength. God is the Strong One because He possesses the utmost and most perfect power.
description_en: Al-Qawiyy reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Qawiyy mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.

al_jalil_commentary: He is the One of perfect, complete strength who is never overcome by inability. Faith in this name should produce humility before God's might, sincere reliance (tawakkul) upon Him alone, and a sense of honor and fearlessness towards creation, knowing their power is nothing compared to Allah's.

proof_text: …And He is the All-Subtle, the All-Aware.
aqeedah_belief: He has knowledge of all things, subtle and hidden, and He shows His immense mercy to His slaves in very subtle ways known to no one but Him.

ghazali_insight: Al-Lateef is the Benevolent one who knows the subtle and hidden aspects of beneficial things and conveys them with gentleness rather than harshness. A man's share in this name is to be gentle with God's servants and guide them to good without rebuke or fanaticism.
description_en: Al-Latif reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Latif mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.

al_jalil_commentary: Al-Lateef is the Subtle and Kind, whose knowledge perceives all secrets and who delivers His mercy through hidden and gentle means. Faith in His subtlety (luṭf) brings tranquility to the believer's heart, especially in hardship. The believer trusts that even disliked events may be a hidden kindness from their Lord, leading to contentment and delegation of their affairs to Him.

english_meaning: The True and Trustworthy, The Granter of security
proof_text: …The Holy, the Source of peace, the Granter of security, the Ever Watchful, the Almighty, the Compeller, the Supremely Great…
aqeedah_belief: Allah testifies to His Oneness and Unity with substantial evidence and confirms the truthfulness of His messengers and their followers. He is also the One who grants peace and security to His slaves, assuring them that He will not wrong them in any way and provides peace and security to His righteou
salah_usage: Renew your shahadah during tashahhud by remembering this Name.
dua_usage: Call Ya Al-Mu'min when asking Allah to guard hearts from fear and hypocrisy.
dhikr_usage: Zikir Ya Al-Mu'min ketika kegusaran muncul supaya jiwa kembali tenteram.
when_to_invoke: Call upon it whenever you fear for your iman or safety.
ghazali_insight: Faithful is the one to whom security 7. Al-Mu'min and safety are ascribed because He conveys the means to attain them and blocks the paths of dangers. For security and safety are only conceivable in locations of fear, and fear only arises with the possibility of annihilation, diminishment or destruction. The absolutely faithful one is God may He be praised and exalted as the one from whose direction alone security an
description_en: Al-Mu'min instills iman, grants security against fear, and guarantees that His promises never fail the believers.
description_ms: Al-Mu'min menanam iman, memberi keselamatan daripada ketakutan, dan memastikan janji-Nya tidak mengecewakan orang beriman.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.29; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv
al_jalil_commentary: Faith in this Name cultivates love for Allah, in whose refuge the fearful find safety and in whose worship the believer finds tranquility. It also leads to having a sound heart towards God's servants, securing them from one's aggression and harm, embodying the prophetic description of a believer as one whom people trust with their lives and property.

proof_text: He is the Knower of the unseen and the visible, the All-Great, the Exalted.

Believing in this name instills humility and warns against becoming arrogant or oppressive. It reminds the servant that God is exalted above all, and no matter how high one may seem, they are always under the authority of the One who is higher.

proof_text: …And Allah encompasses the unbelievers.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One from whom nothing is hidden. He encompasses everything with His knowledge and keeps strict count of all things.
salah_usage: Let this Name soften the heart before takbir so your salah flows with compassion.
dua_usage: Call upon Al-Mujib when pleading for forgiveness for yourself, family, and the ummah.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Mujib dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.
when_to_invoke: Reach for this Name whenever you seek Allah's rahmah after shortcomings.
ghazali_insight: Al-Mujeeb is the one who responds to the requests of those who ask, the call of those who call on Him, and the plight of the poor, even granting favors before the entreaty. A man's share is to be responsive to his Lord's commands and to assist every beggar who asks of him, if able.
description_en: Al-Mujib reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.

The delay may be a trial, a protection from a harmful outcome, or a means by which Allah keeps the servant at the door of supplication and reliance.

proof_text: Allah is sufficient as a Reckoner.
aqeedah_belief: Allah is sufficient for those who rely on Him, is aware of His slaves and will take account of their actions and reward them or punish them accordingly in His immense wisdom and absolute knowledge. He is sufficient for the believers.
dua_usage: Know there is no escape from Him except to Him.
when_to_invoke: Know there is no escape from Him except to Him.

al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Allah as Al-Muheet (The Encompassing) instills fear, modesty, and mindfulness in every thought, word, and step, because His knowledge encompasses all things. It also fosters fear of wronging others, as His power encompasses everything and none can escape Him. For the believer facing enemies, it brings reassurance and diminishes their perceived strength, as Allah encompasses them and their plots.

proof_text: He is Allah, the Creator, the Originator, the Fashioner.
aqeedah_belief: Allah brings into existence whatever He wills in the manner He wills it. He shapes and fashions His creatures in different forms and shapes in His infinite wisdom.
salah_usage: Praise Allah for your limbs and senses each time you enter sujud.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Musawwir when reflecting on Allah's workmanship in yourself and others.

when_to_invoke: Call it whenever you ponder Allah's design in creation and self.

al_jalil_commentary: He is the Fashioner who shapes and forms each of His creations with a unique and distinct image by which it is known. This inspires gratitude for being created in the best of forms and warns against attempting to imitate this divine act by making images of living beings.

This includes spiritual nourishment like faith, guidance, sincerity, and humility, which is the true sustenance; if a person attains it, they are not harmed by what they miss of bodily nourishment.

ghazali_insight: Al-Waasi', the Vast, derives from an expansiveness linked to knowledge when it comprehends a multitude of objects, and to charity when it extends to all. God is the absolutely vast because His knowledge has no shore and the things He can do have no end.
description_en: Al-Wasi reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Wasi mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.45; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Waasi' is the All-Encompassing, whose mercy, provision, and knowledge are without limits. Believing in this name opens a wide door of hope for the servant, especially when facing hardship or the whispers of Satan that encourage miserliness and despair. It fosters trust in Allah's endless bounty and encourages generosity, knowing that His resources are never depleted.

english_meaning: The Loving One and the Beloved One
proof_text: Surely, my Lord is Most Merciful, Most Loving.
aqeedah_belief: Allah loves His prophets, messengers and obedient servants who also love him. He is the most beloved, who deserves to be loved with all our hearts and better than ourselves, better than our children, and better than everyone and everything else we love and cherish.
salah_usage: Let this Name soften the heart before takbir so your salah flows with compassion.
dua_usage: Call upon Al-Wadud when pleading for forgiveness for yourself, family, and the ummah.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Wadud dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.
when_to_invoke: Reach for this Name whenever you seek Allah's rahmah after shortcomings.

al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil notes that the name Al-Wadood is mentioned in conjunction with Al-Ghafoor (The Forgiving). He indicates that the reason for this pairing was discussed in the section for Al-Wadood, implying that Allah's love is connected to His forgiveness for those who turn to Him.

proof_text: Enough is Allah as a disposer of affairs.
aqeedah_belief: Al-Wakeel is the One who disposes of the affairs of all His creatures, the One who provides for them, grants their requests and fulfils their needs. He assists and protects those who seek His refuge, takes charge of His righteous servants' affairs by guiding them to all that is easy, keeping them aw
salah_usage: Let every taslim release burdens into Allah's care.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Wakil when entrusting your plans to Allah's decree.
dhikr_usage: Selitkan Ya Al-Wakil dalam zikir pagi agar hati bergantung kepada Allah sahaja.
when_to_invoke: Use it whenever you place full trust in Allah's decree.
ghazali_insight: Al-Wakeel is the one to whom matters are entrusted. God is the absolute Trustee, to whom all things are entrusted, who is fully capable of carrying them out, and in whom hearts place their trust by His very nature, not by appointment from another.
description_en: Al-Wakil reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Wakil mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.83; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv
al_jalil_commentary: He is the Trustee to whom all affairs are entrusted, the One who is sufficient for and manages all of creation. This inspires sincere reliance (tawakkul) on Him for all needs, both worldly and spiritual, bringing peace to the heart in the knowledge that a perfect, powerful Guardian is in control.

proof_text: … Allah is your Protector—an excellent Protector and an excellent Helper!
aqeedah_belief: He is the guardian who manages everything and disposes of all affairs. Allah, Exalted be He, is the Master of all creation; that is, He is their Creator, Ruler and True God who alone deserves to be worshipped. He loves the believers and provides them with special help and support.
dua_usage: Befriend the believers and rely on Allah's management of your life
when_to_invoke: Befriend the believers and rely on Allah's management of your life
ghazali_insight: Al-Waliyy, the Patron, is a lover and protector who supports the friends of religion and suppresses its enemies. A patron among men is one who befriends God's friends and shows enmity to His enemies, the worst of whom are one's own soul and Satan.
description_en: He is the guardian who manages everything and disposes of all affairs. Allah, Exalted be He, is the Master of all creation; that is, He is their Creator, Ruler and True God who alone deserves to be worshipped. He loves the believers and provides them with special help and support.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.79; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: He is the Protecting Friend and Ally who aids and guides the believers, bringing them from darkness into light. This special friendship (wilayah) is a source of tranquility and confidence for the believer, who strives to earn it through faith and piety.

proof_text: Allah has power over everything.
aqeedah_belief: He has power over all things and is the One who provides sustenance. Allah decrees the needs of His creation, in His immense knowledge, and then provides them with whatever they need according to His will and thus preserves them with whatever He grants them.
salah_usage: Let this Name soften the heart before takbir so your salah flows with compassion.
dua_usage: Call upon Al-Wahhab when pleading for forgiveness for yourself, family, and the ummah.

description_ms: Al-Wahhab mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.

al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Al-Wahhab (The Giver of Gifts) requires the believer to preserve Allah's great gifts, especially the gift of guidance, from being lost. This is achieved by avoiding what causes them to be lost, and by supplicating to Allah for steadfastness, just as the 'firm in knowledge' did when they asked Him not to let their hearts deviate after being guided.

aqeedah_belief: Beautify your heart with sincerity and your appearance with cleanliness.
dua_usage: Beautify your heart with sincerity and your appearance with cleanliness.
when_to_invoke: Beautify your heart with sincerity and your appearance with cleanliness.
ghazali_insight: Al-Jameel, the Beautiful, is the one qualified by beauty. This beauty is not merely external form, but the interior form of majesty and perfection apprehended by insight. God is the truly and absolutely beautiful one, as all beauty and perfection in the world comes from the light of His essence.
description_en: The Beautiful One
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: Allah is beautiful and loves beauty, which should inspire the believer to worship Him through the beauty He loves in words, deeds, and character. One should beautify their tongue with truth and their heart with sincerity, love, and reliance upon Him.

proof_text: …Allah is the Doer of Good and He loves [to see His slaves] do good.
aqeedah_belief: He provides whatever He has created with countless blessings and the One who has perfected, sustained, and guided everything He has created.
dua_usage: Be generous with your wealth and knowledge.
when_to_invoke: Be generous with your wealth and knowledge.
description_en: He provides whatever He has created with countless blessings and the One who has perfected, sustained, and guided everything He has created.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.147; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Al-Jawad (The Generous) should lead one to hope in Him, ask of His bounty, and adopt the quality of generosity. Al-Jalil outlines ten levels of generosity for the believer to practice, including generosity with one's life, position, comfort, knowledge, influence, physical help, honor, patience, cheerful disposition, and by not coveting what is in the hands of others.

proof_text: Shall I then seek a judge other than Allah?
aqeedah_belief: He is the One who judges amongst His slaves, in this life and in the hereafter, with absolute fairness and equity, based on (1) His universal will, (2) His religious legislation and (3) His reward and punishment.
salah_usage: Mention this Name when asking Allah to keep you fair in every responsibility.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Hakam when resolving disputes so you uphold the rights of others.
dhikr_usage: Ulang Ya Al-Hakam sebelum membuat keputusan besar agar keputusan menepati keadilan.
when_to_invoke: Lean on it whenever you decide matters that affect others' rights.
ghazali_insight: st high does not see him! [98] — 29. Al-Hakam — the Arbitrator — is the arbitrating magistrate and the avenging judge, whose ruling no-one overturns and 85 NINETY-NINE NAMES whose decree no-one corrects. Among His rulings concerning men is that man has only what he strives for, and that his effort will be seen (1111:39-40), and that the righteous will meet happiness while the wicked will meet hell-fire (lxxxii: 13-14
description_en: Al-Hakam reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Hakam mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.97; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv
al_jalil_commentary: He is the ultimate Judge to whom all judgment belongs and is returned. Belief in this name requires absolute submission to His judgment, whether it be His universal decree, His religious law, or His final judgment on the Day of Resurrection, and to reject any law that contradicts His.

english_meaning: The One Who honourably disdains anything unbecoming His mercy and generosity
proof_text: O people! Allah is Pure and, therefore, accepts only that which is pure. …
aqeedah_belief: Allah is free of any imperfection. He is good and pure in His being, His actions, His names and His attributes. He loves those who are good and pure and accepts only that which is good and pure.
dua_usage: Be shy to sin against Him. Have high hopes when making Dua.
when_to_invoke: Be shy to sin against Him. Have high hopes when making Dua.
description_en: Allah is free of any imperfection. He is good and pure in His being, His actions, His names and His attributes. He loves those who are good and pure and accepts only that which is good and pure.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.161; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil explains that the name As-Sitteer (The Concealer) is linked to Al-Hayyiy (The Modest), as mentioned in the hadith. This quality means Allah, out of His modesty and desire for concealment, does not expose His servant's sins. Belief in this should inspire love for Him and modesty before Him, as well as the desire to conceal one's own faults and those of others.

proof_text: All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
aqeedah_belief: He is the creator, the owner and disposer of all affairs who bestows His blessings upon His creatures and looks after His righteous servants by setting their hearts aright. This name must not be attributed to other than Allah, Exalted be He. However, when used to refer to other than Allah, it is alw
dua_usage: Acknowledge His lordship by submitting to His commands.
when_to_invoke: Acknowledge His lordship by submitting to His commands.
description_en: He is the creator, the owner and disposer of all affairs who bestows His blessings upon His creatures and looks after His righteous servants by setting their hearts aright. This name must not be attributed to other than Allah, Exalted be He. However, when used to refer to other than Allah, it is always used in the genitive case, to mean 'the owner or proprietor of something', such as rabb al-'usra
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.7; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil discusses the common human error of harboring ill thoughts (ظَنَّ السوء) about God, feeling shortchanged or deserving of more than one has been given. Belief in Him as the Lord (Ar-Rabb) requires trusting His perfect wisdom and justice, compelling the believer to blame their own soul as the source of ignorance and wrongdoing, rather than finding fault with the Most Merciful and Just Ruler.

proof_text: O Allah! I ask You by virtue of the fact that all praise is due to You; none has the right to be worshiped but You, the Bestower…
aqeedah_belief: He is the One who graciously gives favours and gifts even before He is asked. He is the One who shows kindness to His creation by bestowing His blessings upon them and providing them with everything they need. He also bestows His kindness on the righteous believers by guiding them, assisting them an
dua_usage: Be gentle in your dealings; violence does not adorn anything.
when_to_invoke: Be gentle in your dealings; violence does not adorn anything.
description_en: He is the One who graciously gives favours and gifts even before He is asked. He is the One who shows kindness to His creation by bestowing His blessings upon them and providing them with everything they need. He also bestows His kindness on the righteous believers by guiding them, assisting them and granting them true faith.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.143; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Ar-Rafeeq (The Gentle) should lead the believer to adopt the quality of gentleness and deliberation in their affairs, both with themselves and with others. The Prophet Muhammad praised this quality, and it should be practiced by being in the middle ground between haste and carelessness.

proof_text: [You are] the Supremely glorified, the Holy. [You are] the Lord of the angels and of Jibreel.
aqeedah_belief: Allah is free of any imperfection and anything that does not befit His majesty and the One who has no partners. All creation glorifies and declares Him free of any imperfection due to His perfect and beautiful names and attributes.
dua_usage: Glorify Him frequently, especially in bowing and prostration.
when_to_invoke: Glorify Him frequently, especially in bowing and prostration.
description_en: Allah is free of any imperfection and anything that does not befit His majesty and the One who has no partners. All creation glorifies and declares Him free of any imperfection due to His perfect and beautiful names and attributes.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.25; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: As-Subbooh is The Glorified, the one declared free from all imperfection. The author states that belief in this Name inspires a person to frequently remember, glorify, and praise Allah throughout the day and night. This practice brings a feeling of comfort and spiritual peace by joining with all of creation in its continuous glorification of God.

proof_text: Surely, Allah is Al-Witr (i.e. One who has no equal), and He likes Al-Witr [prayer].
aqeedah_belief: He is the One and Unique for whom there is no partner or equal.
dua_usage: Act as a true servant to the true Master.
when_to_invoke: Act as a true servant to the true Master.
description_en: He is the One and Unique for whom there is no partner or equal.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.157; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: Recognizing Allah as the true Master, whose sovereignty is perfect and eternal, leads to dedicating all worship to Him alone. This understanding fosters humility in the believer, preventing them from becoming arrogant with any worldly status, as they know that true mastery belongs only to Allah.

proof_hadith: Reported by Ahmad and Abu Daawood: Saheeh)
proof_text: The Master is Allah.
aqeedah_belief: He is the Master of all creation and all creation without exception are His slaves who turn to none but Him and who act by His command.
dua_usage: Seek medical treatment but believe the cure comes only from Him
when_to_invoke: Seek medical treatment but believe the cure comes only from Him
description_en: He is the Master of all creation and all creation without exception are His slaves who turn to none but Him and who act by His command.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.155; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil clarifies that Ash-Shafi (The Healer) is the true healer of both bodies and hearts, and there is no healing except His. The Quran is a healing for the diseases of the heart, such as ignorance and doubt, and also for physical ailments. The servant's need for the healing of the heart through divine guidance is far greater than the body's need for physical medicine.

proof_text: …Allah is the Giver and I am Al-Qaasim (i.e. the distributor) …
aqeedah_belief: He is the real provider. No one can withhold what He gives, nor can anyone give what He withholds. There is no limit to what He gives, and whatever He gives reaches all His creation.
dua_usage: Ensure your income and food are Halal (pure).
when_to_invoke: Ensure your income and food are Halal (pure).
description_en: He is the real provider. No one can withhold what He gives, nor can anyone give what He withholds. There is no limit to what He gives, and whatever He gives reaches all His creation.

al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Allah as At-Tayyib (The Pure, The Good) means recognizing He only accepts that which is 'tayyib'. This guides a believer to strive to offer only what is pure and good in their words, deeds, and earnings, and to seek out the purest in all aspects of life.

description_en: Al-Mu'akhkhir reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.

al_jalil_commentary: This name should be paired with Al-Muqaddim. Believing in them instills reliance on Allah alone, as He controls all advancement and delay. True advancement is progress in obedience to Allah and towards His pleasure, while true delay is falling behind in that pursuit. The believer thus asks Allah to be advanced in what is good and not be delayed from it.

english_meaning: The One Who acts in a good and fine manner
proof_hadith: Reported by At-Tirmidhee and Abu Daawood)
proof_text: Allah, Glorified and Sublime be He, is modest and concealing, and He loves modesty and concealment…
aqeedah_belief: Allah always covers His slaves' faults and never exposes them. He also likes them to conceal their sins and avoid whatever is bound to dishonour them, being aware of His presence and showing Him the respect due to Him.
dua_usage: Practice *Ihsan* (excellence) in worship and dealings.
when_to_invoke: Practice *Ihsan* (excellence) in worship and dealings.
ghazali_insight: Al-Muhsin is the beneficent one (doer of good) from whom every good deed and beneficence originates. A man can be a 'doer of good' to the extent that he occupies himself with doing good, especially to his parents, teachers, and elders.

al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Al-Muhsin (The Beneficent) motivates one to adorn themselves with the quality of Ihsan (excellence, beneficence), as Allah is Muhsin and loves the Muhsinin. Ihsan for the servant has two aspects: Ihsan in the worship of Allah, which is to worship Him as if you see Him; and Ihsan towards the creation, by delivering all kinds of good to them.

proof_text: Allah is beautiful and loves beauty.
aqeedah_belief: He has the best and perfect qualities. He is Beautiful in His Being, and all His names, attributes and actions are also beautiful.
dua_usage: Acknowledge that all you have is a gift from Him.
when_to_invoke: Acknowledge that all you have is a gift from Him.
description_en: He has the best and perfect qualities. He is Beautiful in His Being, and all His names, attributes and actions are also beautiful.

al_jalil_commentary: Understanding that Allah is the true Giver leads to directing all requests for benefit and protection from harm to Him alone, as no created being can give or withhold anything without His permission. It also inspires the believer to be generous with what Allah has given them.

proof_text: Allah is Most Generous and He loves generosity.
aqeedah_belief: He gives abundantly to all His creatures without exception and bestows on them His kindness and countless graces and blessings. He exclusively bestows on the righteous believers certain blessings in this life and in the hereafter.
dua_usage: Do not remind people of your favors to them (don't be a *mannan*), for true bestowal is from Allah.
when_to_invoke: Do not remind people of your favors to them (don't be a *mannan*), for true bestowal is from Allah.
description_en: He gives abundantly to all His creatures without exception and bestows on them His kindness and countless graces and blessings. He exclusively bestows on the righteous believers certain blessings in this life and in the hereafter.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.145; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil explains that belief in Al-Mannan (The Bestower of Favors) should lead the believer away from the blameworthy trait of reminding others of one's charity to them. Allah has forbidden this among people but has ascribed it to Himself, as His favor is a true endowment and reminder of grace, whereas from humans it is a form of reproach and degradation. Since Allah is the true giver, one should avoid this trait.

al_jalil_commentary: Since Allah is Al-Witr (The One, The Odd), and He loves the 'witr', a believer should be keen to perform and conclude their sayings and actions with an odd number where prescribed by the Sunnah. This includes the Witr prayer, which concludes the prayers of the night.
